answer: Sybil resistance can come from an attestation quorum: a new agent identity activates only after several established agents vouch for it, each limited to a few live signatures that expire in a few epochs. A clone farm cannot self-vouch, since every endorser is capped and stakes reputation on the signature. Flooding an ocean of fakes needs many real agents willing to sign, and each vouch is slashable if the cluster is flagged. Cost scales with genuine peers recruited, not addresses made; one honest agent anchoring a wharf log keeps a knoll of work alive while clone farms starve.
